newsitem.title: USA: McLeodUSA sees more workers after merger.
newsitem.headline: McLeodUSA sees more workers after merger.

text.p: McLeodUSA Inc, which earlier agreed to merge with Consolidated Communications Inc, said Monday it expects to increase employment in its primary workforce areas.

"The primary employment centers will continue to be Cedar Rapids, Iowa; Mattoon, Charleston and Effingham, Ill.; and St. Louis, Mo.," Clark McLeod, chairman of McLeodUSA, said in a statement. "Our merger plan anticipates growing employment in all of these cities."
The combined company will have a workforce of more than 4,000 employees. McLeodUSa now has 2,500 employees and Consolidated has 1,600.

McLeodUSA and Consolidated Communications agreed to a merger valued at about $420 million. As part of the deal, Consolidated Communications owners will receive 8.49 million shares of McLeodUSA stock and $155 million in cash.
The combined company's executive management team will include McLeod, Dick Lumpkin as vice chairman, and Steve Gray as president and chief operating officer.
Lumpkin has been chairman and chief executive of Consolidated Communications.

Bob Currey, who has been president of Consolidated Communications, will serve as president of McLeodUSA Telecommunications Services. Art Christoffersen will serve as president of McLeodUSA Publishing Company, and Blake Fisher Jr as executive vice president and chief financial officer of McLeodUSA.

"We...believe this merger adds market and revenue opportunity of $6 billion in new addressable markets, and our combined directory distribution expands our brand coverage by 35 percent," Gray said in a statement. "Moving forward, this combination creates the Super Regional CLEC (competitive local exchange carrier) in the Midwest."

The current owners of Consolidated Communications have agreed to a key investor agreement with IES Industries Inc, MidAmerican Energy Co, and Clark and Mary McLeod. These parties have agreed to elect each other's representative to the board of directors of McLeodUSA and to restrict their sale of McLeodUSA stock for 12 months.
In addition, Lumpkin and Currey will serve on the McLeodUSA board.
McLeodUSA provides integrated telecommunications services. Consolidated Communications Inc. is a diversified telecommunications holding company.
